attribution.actuation: API submission, acknowledged spec, observed status, actual cgroups; separate from CPU computation
attribution.application: application cgroup CPU, memory, throttle and OOM
attribution.controller: must be separate from generator; thread CPU for local computation; process RSS/CPU separately
attribution.maintenance: separate profile process CPU/RSS + step thread CPU/wall + startup/warmup
attribution.status: separate worker processes required; no shared generator/controller CPU attribution
attribution.telemetry: Prometheus container + collector separate process, including telemetry HTTP probe cost

bootstrap.initialization: thresholds from valid bootstrap only; production factory initialization
bootstrap.missing: absent slots remain missing; no fill or extension; reject insufficient fixed bootstrap
bootstrap.visibility: completed host-receipt bucket; host admission <= initialization read; cluster source <= cluster receipt

clock_observations.causal_domain: source and loopback receiver share Linux boot/time namespace
clock_observations.host_vm_difference: diagnostic only; never absolute causal comparison
clock_observations.receipt_boundary: complete source body received in cluster; complete envelope received on host before admission
clock_observations.rejection: fail closed; isolated raw body + context/hash; never scientific telemetry

consumer.rule: ceil(headroom * maintained p95 physical value / quantum) * quantum then clamp; requests=limits; classes diagnostic only
consumer.signal_inputs: CPU/memory maintained p95 only; no SLO feedback, prediction, adaptive detector, smoothing or tuned hysteresis

engineering_plan.approval: execution authorized; reserved host not asserted
engineering_plan.calibration_count_status: predeclared neutral-method calibration: 3 runs per scenario, 6 maximum

estimation.ci_method: paired-block percentile bootstrap, pointwise 95%; no familywise or practical superiority claim
estimation.dominance: all six minimization dimensions no better, at least one strictly worse; equality is not strict dominance
estimation.dominance_scope: point-estimate ordering only; uncertainty reported jointly; not population dominance or practical superiority
estimation.effects: method minus control; arithmetic mean and median of paired run differences
estimation.otherwise: report resource-SLO/latency trade-off without choosing a winner
estimation.paired_unit: predeclared randomized/counterbalanced block; identical offered trace and seed

failure_policy.implementation_status: continuous collection and operational-failure retention still required
failure_policy.rule: retain every attempt; operational harms are outcomes, not exclusions; correctness fixes invalidate affected generation

hardware.calibration_context: research workstation; background interference monitored, no reservation assertion
hardware.confirmatory_control: freeze matched controlled hardware before comparative execution
hardware.unavailable_diagnostics: record unavailable; no fabricated thermal readings

host_execution.maintenance_and_session: no reboot/update/logout during run; operator-controlled maintenance window

kubernetes.actuation: pods/resize strategic merge; NotRequired restart policy; no rollout fallback
kubernetes.note: pinned stable in-place resize environment; 1.33 rejected no-restart memory decrease; no controller parameter changes
kubernetes.resource_qos: Guaranteed: requests equal limits before/after resize

operational_contract.latency_target_status: V7A engineering target, not an approved operational SLO

precision.no_target_disposition: report limitation and leave comparative execution disabled; practical margins are not required
precision.rule: report neutral-run variance and precision-versus-N curves; freeze N only for a prospective justified precision target, never significance
precision.targets_status: NOT_DEFINED; do not infer precision goals from favorable effects

references.rule: fixed bootstrap reference, never current changing requests

slo.violation: failed/timed-out/dropped OR arrival-to-completion > target, divided by offered requests

telemetry.cpu: counter difference over source monotonic span for host-receipt-selected samples; no extrapolation
telemetry.fence: host receipt inside (bucket_start,bucket_end]; host admission before algorithm use; source causality checked only against cluster receipt; incomplete buckets absent
telemetry.late_read: record wall receive/commit/read times separately from nominal policy slot; never consume incomplete source
telemetry.memory: mean of actual cgroup working-set bytes in bucket

workload.arrival: deterministic open loop; overload drops recorded as failures
workload.generator_location: host through fixed localhost kubectl port-forward; transport part of measured system, not production ingress
